method: Each URL below was re-opened in this pass and the price, karat and (where published) the metal weight were read off the page again. The old value is what earlier passes stored; the new value is what the page said on this read. Where a value is unchanged the row keeps its original evidence string and gains reverified_at. Where a value moved, the row is corrected and the move is logged as a flag.

not_reverified.why: This pass re-read 7 of 43 rows and one market feed. The rest keep the retrieval date of the pass that captured them, and the site shows that date on every row. Re-reading all 43 would require fetching every product page again; the collector script does that when run with network access.

note: One ledger for every live re-read in pass P12, written by two sessions that worked the same pass independently (bc088451 on main, b93ff7c6 on its own branch).
